Container.Name: ndi-dockrecorder
Container.Overview: Headless NDI recorder with replay buffer, Stream Deck integration and Fireshare output. Exposes a web dashboard on port 3000.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web dashboard and API.

Config.Name: Data directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for settings.db and profiles.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal port the Node.js server listens on (must match the port mapping above).

Config.Name: REPLAY_BUFFER_MINUTES
Config.Description: Duration of the replay buffer in minutes (5, 10 or 15).

Config.Name: RECORDING_DIR
Config.Description: Internal path where recordings are written (should match the Recordings directory volume target).

Config.Name: SETTINGS_DB
Config.Description: Path to the SQLite settings database inside the container.

Config.Name: NDI_ACCESS_IPS
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of IP addresses allowed to access NDI streams (e.g. 192.168.1.10,192.168.1.20). Leave empty to allow all.
